note: the graded episode's service (graded_service.py), dual mode (experiment): public constants only; the hidden episode is episode.json and state/, which only the worker reads (state/ through its kitchen process). code_dir holds byte copies of the grader's tests/kitchen_sim.py, sim_worker.py and wire_rules.py and state_dir the graded state's three files (byte copies of tests/hidden/), both installed by setup.sh (root-owned, group longgrade, readable by that group only) from online/code and online/state; code_sha256 and state_sha256 pin every file (the worker refuses to start on a difference). robocasa_dir is the image's second RoboCasa tree: the same pinned commit with the graded kitchens' assets installed as tests/Dockerfile installs them for the grader, owned by the account longgrade (RoboCasa writes its temporary model files there); the kitchen process imports RoboCasa from it (PYTHONPATH). sim_env is the grader's environment for its kitchen process (tests/verify.py _sim_env), with the service's own HOME. prep_s is the agent's budget on main ([agent] timeout_sec 28800): the episode must be started within it; graded_s is the window from the start to the episode's latest end. The freeze (DM3): at the graded start, or when prep_s runs out without one, the root supervisor copies submission_dir into record_dir/snapshot_name (no link followed; only regular files and folders of the agent's account; main's caps: snapshot_max_files 5000 entries that are not folders and snapshot_max_bytes 200 MiB, counted as the offline grader's stage_submission counts them; the engine's depth limit; over any: snapshot_status too_large and no copy).
